build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay). Revision v2: the client reviewed v1 (a night storefront exterior with only a celeste accent in the text layer) and asked for two fixes -- (1) a real Guatemalan flag or quetzal, the piece looked too bare without one, and (2) a scene that unmistakably reads as a barbershop, the chairs seen through the storefront glass didn't read as barber chairs. Backgrounds regenerated with scripts/kie_image_gen.mjs (kie.ai gpt-image-2-text-to-image, feed at aspect-ratio 3:4 / resolution 2K, story at 9:16 / 2K) as a barbershop interior -- classic barber chair with black leather upholstery and chrome pedestal, large wall mirror, styling station with visible tools (clippers, razor, scissors, bottles), same vocabulary as the proven posts/instagram/horario-especial-15-septiembre/ and posts/instagram/dia-partido-camiseta/ prompts. The v1 exterior backgrounds are kept for reference at raw/bg-v1-exterior.png and raw/bg-v1-exterior-story.png. Deliberate brand exception #2 (on top of the celeste accent already used in the text layer, unchanged from v1): a real Guatemalan flag -- three vertical bands, light sky-blue/white/light sky-blue, no coat of arms -- hangs on the wall as real fabric, rendered in full natural color, the only full-color element in an otherwise black-and-white duotone photograph with a warm gold key light. Same 'full color, deliberate brand exception' pattern and wording already used in posts/instagram/mundial-bandera-argentina/raw/bg.json (flag as a physical object, described band-by-band, rest of the frame pinned back to the duotone look) and posts/instagram/dia-partido-camiseta/ (one full-color element inside an otherwise duotone barbershop interior). Text/logo layer is real HTML+CSS (index.html / index-story.html), unchanged from v1: celeste (#4997D0) pill, headline highlight word, and a thin celeste/bone/celeste flag-rule divider under the headline -- kept because it now echoes the flag's own colors in the photo rather than standing alone. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). This is a purely commemorative post (no hours, no price, no booking CTA) -- distinct from the operational posts/instagram/horario-especial-15-septiembre/ post about special hours on the same date; do not merge or confuse the two.
